images.alt:
Had lyrics, dropped down songs from my collection, handled ~50,000 files without blinking.

And because it was built as a Win8 app, nobody ever saw it :-(

Their marketplace at the time showed "New Apps" only if they had more than 10,000 downloads 🤦.

And nobody cared about Windows 8 apps, like at all.

Great product.

Horrible targeting decision on my part and bad timing, too.

record.text:
Lol yeah, me too!

Do not get me started on Win8.

Sad part for me is that I spent 4 months on an awesome music player... and released it as a Win8 app.

I'm so glad Team "New Start Menu is Awful" won and Windows 10 went back.
